description: Check if a deployed application is healthy by making an HTTP request to its URL (10-second timeout). Returns status_code, response_time_ms, and whether the app is reachable. For an App behind sign-in, its URL answers with Cloudflare Access's sign-in page whatever the app does, so the answer has protected: true and comes from Telbase's view instead (the service running, its last deploy live), not from a request to the app. Use service_id (an id or name such as api) for one of an App's further services. Use after deploy to verify the app is serving traffic, or to diagnose health check failures.

service_id.description: Optional service ID for multi-service projects.

name: check_app_health
